scientific_integrity: The rational recurrence and infinite-product arguments supply the proof; finite checks are auxiliary. Earlier random convergence, ellipse-preservation, and convergence-in-shape theorems are credited.
scientific_limitations: Centered planar ellipses only, rather than arbitrary convex bodies. Uniform exponential energy coefficient not claimed globally optimal. Independent historical priority verification remains open.
title: A directional-energy dichotomy for iterated planar Steiner ellipses
